purpose: Provider-agnostic deterministic regression suite for custom/system/developer instruction adherence. Diagnostic only; never a worker target, scheduler input, or substitute for task outcome proof.

design_sources.name: IFEval
design_sources.principle: programmatically verifiable constraints; strict all-instructions scoring

design_sources.name: FollowBench
design_sources.principle: separate hard all-constraint satisfaction from per-constraint soft satisfaction

design_sources.name: IH-Challenge / System IFEval
design_sources.principle: higher-priority instruction opposed by a lower-priority instruction; deterministic grading
design_sources.reference: OpenAI, Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs, 2026-03-10

design_sources.name: IFBench
design_sources.principle: challenging/OOD constraints and multi-turn constraint isolation

design_sources.name: SystemCheck
design_sources.principle: treat system-prompt reliability as a dedicated benchmark surface and combine complementary S-IFEval/RealGuardrails/TensorTrust-style probes
design_sources.reference: SystemCheck / A Closer Look at System Prompt Robustness, arXiv:2502.12197

guardrails: All included checks are deterministic; no LLM judge is used.
Cases are original minimal probes inspired by public benchmark structures, not copied benchmark prompts.
A custom-instruction deployment should inject its real custom instruction block at the highest supported role, then append each case's adversarial/lower-priority messages.
Score instruction adherence separately from lifecycle reliability and real task acceptance; do not average unlike signals into one opaque score without calibration.
